email.subject: Smile Dentistry's site on mobile
email.body:
Jack,

Checked Smile Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you patients: it's not set up for mobile, so anyone searching on their phone (most people) hits a broken layout and probably just calls the next dentist instead. And there's no hours listed anywhere, so people can't tell if you're open before they bother calling. The site's also slow to load from oversized images, which doesn't help.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
